import re
xml=open('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').read()
# print rows compactly: extract row elements
rows = re.findall(r'<row.*?</row>|<row[^>]*/>', xml, re.S)
print('num rows', len(rows))
for row in rows:
    r = re.search(r' r=\"(\d+)\"', row)
    rn = r.group(1) if r else '?'
    cells = re.findall(r'<c r=\"([A-Z]+\d+)\"(?: s=\"(\d+)\")?(?: t=\"(\w+)\")?(?:/>|>(.*?)</c>)', row, re.S)
    out=[]
    for cell in cells:
        ref, style, t, content = cell
        content = content.replace('<f>','F[').replace('</f>',']')
        if '<v>' in content:
            v = re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>', content, re.S)
            content='V='+ (v.group(1) if v else '?')
        out.append(f'{ref}(s{style},t={t},{content})')
    print(rn, ' '.join(out))
"
